entities.name: Emil
entities.description: A middle-aged Wojek officer who investigated a Cult of Rakdos massacre in Merrytown.

entities.name: Wojek
entities.description: The law enforcement organization Emil served in.

entities.name: Cult of Rakdos
entities.description: Guild whose massacre in Merrytown Emil investigated.

entities.name: Merrytown
entities.description: A place plagued by crime and decay.

entities.name: Titan's Keg
entities.description: A tavern in Merrytown that was burned.

entities.name: Orik
entities.description: A massive troll and former bouncer of the Titan's Keg, affiliated with the Rakdos guild.

entities.name: Vatek
entities.description: A character with eccentricities whom Emil handled calmly.

entities.name: Piggy
entities.description: A zombie involved in the tavern incident.

entities.name: Uzric
entities.description: A Rakdos guildmage who orchestrated the troll's presence to relay information.

events.summary: Emil is tasked with investigating the burning of the Titan's Keg tavern.
events.quote: Emil was tasked with investigating the burning of the Titan’s Keg tavern.

events.summary: Emil interviews Orik and learns grotesque details of the night's events, involving goblins, an imp and the zombie Piggy.
events.quote: Emil engaged in a conversation with Orik, a massive troll and former bouncer of the tavern.

events.summary: Emil learns that Uzric orchestrated the troll's presence; Orik, under magical influence, explodes, killing everyone present and leveling a third of Merrytown.
events.quote: Orik, under magical influence, self-destructed in a fiery explosion, killing everyone present and leveling a third of Merrytown.

relations.quote: Orik's intimidating appearance and affiliation with the Rakdos guild

relations.note: orchestrated Orik's presence and magically influenced him
relations.quote: Uzric, a Rakdos guildmage, orchestrated the presence of the troll to relay information about the incident
